title: City Chic Escape - 1 Mile Walk from Broadway
description:
Muse | City-view condo with high speed WiFi, central AC, & rooftop lounge

The space
Indulge in the vibrant energy of Nashville from this lively condo, situated less than a mile away from Honky Tonk Row. Immerse yourself in the colorful ambiance throughout the space, promising an exciting stay. Sink into the plush sofa for relaxation in front of the TV, while the well-equipped kitchen awaits your culinary adventures. Each bedroom features its own TV, ensuring personalized entertainment without disruption. Revel in stunning city views from the comfort of your home.

Additional amenities include cable and streaming services, central air-conditioning, and a record player with an eclectic collection. For extra guests, a cozy bunk bed in the common area is at your disposal.

Guest access
You have access to the entirety of the home!

Other things to note
- Streaming is available using your own accounts.
- A shared laundry room is available on-site.
- The Drip Bar, located next door, is now an official Bounce luggage drop location for guest convenience. 
- No pets are allowed at this vacation rental.
- This rental is located on floor 4.
Parking notes: No parking available.
